
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(modelsummary)
df_params <- read_csv(
  "/Users/sm6511/Desktop/Prediction-Accomodation-Exp/data/Combined/df_params_by_explanation_for_R-Study1.csv"
) |>
  mutate(
    explanation_group = factor(
      explanation_group,
      levels = c(
        "predictor",
        "non_explainer",
        "causal_explainer"
      ),
      labels = c(
      "Predict",
      "Accommodate\n(No Causal Explanation)",
      "Accommodate\n(Causal Explanation)"
      )
    ),
    model_param_score = factor(
      model_param_score,
      levels = 0:3
    )
  )

```
```{r}
contingency_all <- table(
  df_params$explanation_group,
  df_params$model_param_score
)

contingency_all

chi_test <- chisq.test(contingency_all)

chi_test

# Observed counts
chi_test$observed

# Expected counts
chi_test$expected
plot_df <- df_params |>
  count(
    explanation_group,
    model_param_score,
    name = "n"
  ) |>
  group_by(explanation_group) |>
  mutate(
    proportion = n / sum(n)
  ) |>
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    y = explanation_group,
    x = proportion,
    fill = model_param_score
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = paste0("", n)
    ),
    position = position_stack(
      vjust = 0.5,
      reverse = TRUE
    ),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    labels = scales::percent
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Proportion",
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Complexity score"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)
```





#STATS: Importance

```{r}

df_long4 <- read_csv(
  "/Users/sm6511/Desktop/Prediction-Accomodation-Exp/data/Combined/df_long_by_explanation_for_R-Study1.csv"
) |>
  mutate(
    participant = factor(participant),

    feature_relevance = relevel(
      factor(feature_relevance),
      ref = "relevant"
    ),

    feature_dimension = factor(
      feature_dimension,
      levels = c("color", "shape", "tail")
    ),

    # Three-condition grouping (now with causal explainers)
    feature_explanation_group = case_when(
      task == "predict" ~ "Predict",

      task == "accommodate" &
        had_causal_explanation_for_feature == TRUE ~ "Accommodate\n(Causal Explanation)",

      task == "accommodate" &
        (
          had_causal_explanation_for_feature == FALSE |
          is.na(had_causal_explanation_for_feature)
        ) ~ "Accommodate\n(No Causal Explanation)",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # Predictor as reference level
    feature_explanation_group = factor(
      feature_explanation_group,
      levels = c(
        "Predict",
        "Accommodate\n(Causal Explanation)",
        "Accommodate\n(No Causal Explanation)"
      )
    )
  )

# Effect / sum coding
contrasts(df_long4$feature_explanation_group) <- contr.sum(3)
contrasts(df_long4$feature_relevance) <- contr.sum(2)
contrasts(df_long4$feature_dimension) <- contr.sum(3)

model_eff <- lmer(
  feature_importance ~
    feature_explanation_group * feature_relevance * feature_dimension +
    (1 | participant),
  data = df_long4
)

summary(model_eff)

# Omnibus test
joint_tests(model_eff)
# Estimated marginal means
emm <- emmeans(
  model_eff,
  ~ feature_explanation_group * feature_dimension
)

emm

# Pairwise condition comparisons within each relevance level
pairs(
  emm,
  by = "feature_dimension",
  adjust = "tukey"
)
```


#PLOTTING: Importance

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

df_long4 <- read_csv(
  "/Users/sm6511/Desktop/Prediction-Accomodation-Exp/data/Combined/df_long_by_explanation_for_R-Study1.csv"
) |>
  mutate(
    feature_relevance = relevel(
      factor(feature_relevance),
      ref = "irrelevant"
    ),

    feature_dimension = factor(
      feature_dimension,
      levels = c("color", "shape", "tail"),
      labels = c("Color", "Shape", "Tail")
    ),

    # Feature-specific explanation grouping
    feature_explanation_group = case_when(
      task == "predict" ~ "Predict",

      task == "accommodate" &
        had_causal_explanation_for_feature == TRUE ~ "Accommodate\n(Causal Explanation)",

      task == "accommodate" &
        (
          had_causal_explanation_for_feature == FALSE |
          is.na(had_causal_explanation_for_feature)
        ) ~ "Accommodate\n(No Causal Explanation)",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    feature_explanation_group = factor(
      feature_explanation_group,
      levels = c(
        "Accommodate\n(Causal Explanation)",
        "Accommodate\n(No Causal Explanation)",
        "Predict"
      )
    )
  )

plot_summary <- df_long4 |>
  filter(
    !is.na(feature_explanation_group),
    !is.na(feature_dimension),
    !is.na(feature_importance)
  ) |>
  group_by(
    feature_dimension,
    feature_explanation_group
  ) |>
  summarise(
    mean_importance = mean(feature_importance, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_importance = sd(feature_importance, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    se_importance = sd_importance / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

plot_summary

ggplot(
  plot_summary,
  aes(
    x = feature_dimension,
    y = mean_importance,
    fill = feature_explanation_group
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.7,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_importance - se_importance,
      ymax = mean_importance + se_importance
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      y = -.5,
      label = paste0("", n)
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    size = 2.5,
    vjust = 1
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-.5, 7.5)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Feature",
    y = "Mean feature importance",
    fill = "Condition"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)
```

```{r}

# Load data
df_corr2 <- read_csv(
  "/Users/sm6511/Desktop/Prediction-Accomodation-Exp/data/Combined/df_corr_by_explanation_for_R-Study1.csv"
) |>
  mutate(
    participant = factor(participant),

    feature_relevance = factor(
      feature_relevance,
      levels = c("irrelevant", "relevant")
    ),

    feature_dimension = factor(
      feature_dimension,
      levels = c("color", "shape", "tail")
    ),

    feature_explanation_group = factor(
      feature_explanation_group,
      levels = c(
        "explainer",
        "non_explainer",
        "predictor"
      ),
      labels = c(
        "Accommodate\n(Causal Explanation)",
        "Accommodate\n(No Causal Explanation)",
        "Predict"
      )
    )
  )

# effect coding for omnibus tests
contrasts(df_corr2$feature_explanation_group) <- contr.sum(3)
contrasts(df_corr2$feature_relevance) <- contr.sum(2)
contrasts(df_corr2$feature_dimension) <- contr.sum(3)

#model
model_corr <- lmer(
  correlation ~
    feature_explanation_group *
    feature_relevance *
    feature_dimension +
    (1 | participant),
  data = df_corr2
)

joint_tests(model_corr)

# Follow-up pairwise comparisons

#  every group × relevance × dimension combination
emm_corr <- emmeans(
  model_corr,
  ~ feature_explanation_group |
    feature_relevance * feature_dimension
)

# All 3 pairwise group comparisons within each
# relevance × feature-dimension combination
pairs(
  emm_corr,
  adjust = "tukey"
)
```


```{r}

# Check participant counts in each feature-specific group
df_corr2 |>
  count(
    feature_dimension,
    feature_explanation_group
  )


# Calculate mean correlations, SDs, SEs, and participant counts
corr_plot_summary <- df_corr2 |>
  filter(
    !is.na(feature_explanation_group),
    !is.na(feature_dimension),
    !is.na(correlation)
  ) |>
  group_by(
    feature_dimension,
    feature_explanation_group
  ) |>
  summarise(
    mean_correlation = mean(
      correlation,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    sd_correlation = sd(
      correlation,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    n = n_distinct(participant),
    se_correlation = sd_correlation / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

corr_plot_summary


# Plot mean correlation by feature-specific explanation group
ggplot(
  corr_plot_summary,
  aes(
    x = feature_dimension,
    y = mean_correlation,
    fill = feature_explanation_group
  )
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.7,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_correlation - se_correlation,
      ymax = mean_correlation + se_correlation
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      y = -0.05,
      label = paste0("", n)
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    size = 2.5,
    vjust = 1
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-0.1, 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Feature",
    y = "Mean correlation",
    fill = "Condition"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)
```

###ERROR

```{r}
df_merged <- read_csv('/Users/sm6511/Desktop/Prediction-Accomodation-Exp/data/Combined/df_merged_for_R-Study1.csv') |>
  mutate(
    task = relevel(factor(task), ref = "predict"),

    color_relevance = ifelse(irrelevant_dim == "color", "irrelevant", "relevant"),
    tail_relevance  = ifelse(irrelevant_dim == "tail",  "irrelevant", "relevant"),
    shape_relevance  = ifelse(irrelevant_dim == "shape",  "irrelevant", "relevant"),

    color_match_high = ifelse(color == color_high, 1, 0),
    tail_match_high  = ifelse(tail  == tail_high,  1, 0),
    shape_match_high  = ifelse(shape  == shape_high,  1, 0)
  )
```

```{r}
df_cue <- df_merged |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(color_match_high, tail_match_high, shape_match_high),
    names_to = "feature_dimension",
    values_to = "match_high"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    feature_dimension = str_remove(feature_dimension, "_match_high"),
    feature_relevance = case_when(
      feature_dimension == "color" ~ color_relevance,
      feature_dimension == "tail"  ~ tail_relevance,
      feature_dimension == "shape"  ~ shape_relevance
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(
    task, participant,
    relevant_dim_1, relevant_dim_2, irrelevant_dim,causal_color, causal_tail, causal_shape,
    feature_dimension, feature_relevance
  ) |>
  summarise(
    pred = mean(testing_responses[match_high == 1], na.rm = TRUE) -
           mean(testing_responses[match_high == 0], na.rm = TRUE),

    true = mean(food_amount[match_high == 1], na.rm = TRUE) -
           mean(food_amount[match_high == 0], na.rm = TRUE),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
  feature_explanation_group = case_when(
    task == "predict" ~ "predictor",

    task == "accommodate" &
      feature_dimension == "color" &
      causal_color ~ "explainer",

    task == "accommodate" &
      feature_dimension == "tail" &
      causal_tail ~ "explainer",

    task == "accommodate" &
      feature_dimension == "shape" &
      causal_shape ~ "explainer",

    task == "accommodate" ~ "non_explainer"
  ),

  feature_explanation_group = factor(
    feature_explanation_group,
    levels = c("explainer", "non_explainer", "predictor"),
    labels = c("Explainer", "Non-explainer", "Predictor")
  )
)|>
  
  mutate(
    signed_error = pred - true,
    abs_error = abs(pred - true),

    task = relevel(factor(task), ref = "predict"),
    feature_dimension = relevel(factor(feature_dimension), ref = "tail"),
    feature_relevance = relevel(factor(feature_relevance), ref = "irrelevant")
  )
```
